currentWork.title: AN15 intelligence v2 hardening
currentWork.releaseStatus: AN15A-G2 sidecar/API foundations are merged. GitHub Pages for AN15G2 head passed. Vercel deployment of /api/explain is externally rate-limited, so Gemini production transport verification remains pending.
scope: AN15A forecast ledger/scoring foundation exists but is not yet automatically wired to production forecast creation and later confirmed outcome scoring.
AN15B bounded self-calibration is evaluation-only and must not affect live forecasts until enough exact scored real samples and walk-forward evidence exist.

AN15C context-response learning is evaluation-only; weather must remain unknown unless supplied by a reliable observed source. Its promotion comparison must be incremental against the AN15B-calibrated baseline.
AN15D machine profiles and AN15D2 cross-machine pooling backtest are descriptive/evaluation-only; pooling is not live.
AN15E substitution v2 is confirmed-event, non-causal evidence only.
AN15F joint optimizer is proposal-only and performs no downstream writes.
AN15G/G2 explanation layer has no numeric authority. /api/explain is separate from OCR and has deterministic fallback.
OPS10C remains withdrawn; preserve existing Today nearest-machine ordering.
nextActions: Wire AN15A snapshot creation to the real production forecast lifecycle without changing forecast values.
Score only safely matched later confirmed sales outcomes and preserve censored semantics.
Make AN15C incremental evaluation compare against AN15B-calibrated baseline.
Add executable no-lookahead/idempotency/censoring/sparse-data tests for AN15A-C before any numeric promotion.
Verify /api/explain against Gemini after the external Vercel deployment rate limit clears.

unresolved: Vercel production deployment of AN15G2 /api/explain is rate-limited externally.
AN15A-C production lifecycle integration and executable tests are not complete.
